behavior.global_preflight: inventory/size plus manifest-bound stat cache; re-hash changed-stat files only
behavior.legacy_destructive_guard: hash every tracked file in the component being overwritten against the prior manifest; stat cache is never trusted for destructive replacement
behavior.final_manifest: reuse unchanged hashes; hash rebuilt/changed/new/size-changed files
behavior.full_integrity_command: verify-output / verify-rip remains full SHA-256 by default
behavior.force_modified: explicit override; final manifest re-hashes all actual files
behavior.fresh_rip_cache: OUTPUT_STAT_CACHE.json generated from freshly hashed output manifest
behavior.refresh_assets_override: cannot be short-circuited by already_current profile check
behavior.saved_option_authority: explicit modern convert_obj=false is not overridden by aggregate OBJ output counts

boundaries: filesystem size/mtime is a routine global read-avoidance hint; it is never trusted to authorize destructive component overwrite
full independent whole-rip re-hash remains explicit Verify Rip

retail_xbox_external_benchmark.source: project-owner retained Xbox 360 retail package; not bundled
retail_xbox_external_benchmark.environment_note: wall-clock timings are environment-specific and are validation evidence, not a guaranteed performance target
